# Ordinance No. 09, Series of 2011

**Reclassifying Agricultural Land to Commercial Land**

## Summary

This ordinance reclassifies the agricultural land owned by [[Edmundo Pardilla]] in Barangay Amontay, Pitogo, Quezon, with Transfer Certificate of Title T-513557 and an area of 600 sq. meters, to commercial land for the purpose of establishing a gasoline station. The ordinance mandates the owner/developer to pay the necessary fees and charges before the issuance of the Resolution/Certificate and takes effect ten (10) days after its publication.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1.** Reclassifies the agricultural land owned by [[Edmundo Pardilla]] located at Brgy. Amontay, Pitogo, Quezon with Transfer Certificate of Title T-513557 and a total area of 600 sq. meters to commercial land (gasoline station).
2.  **Section 2.** Requires the owner/developer to pay the Municipal Treasurer the necessary fees and charges before the issuance of Resolution/Certificate.
3.  **Section 3.** States that the Ordinance shall take effect ten (10) days after its publication upon approval.

## Entities

- [[Edmundo Pardilla]] — Land Owner/Developer
- [[Sangguniang Bayan]] of Pitogo, Quezon — Enacting Body
- [[Municipal Treasurer]] — Responsible for collecting fees and charges

## Legal Basis (RA 7160 Sections)

- [[RA-7160|Republic Act No. 7160]] (Local Government Code of 1991)
  - Rule VII Art. 38 Implementing Rules and Regulation of RA 7160

## Timeline

- [[2011-11-14]]: Ordinance enacted during the regular session of the [[Sangguniang Bayan]]
